CommunityApplications.Profile:
DOOM, from the sources id Software released in 1997, built and run inside the container and played in a browser. The engine only ever supported an 8-bit PseudoColor X visual, which no current X server offers, so the container brings its own and exports it over noVNC - nothing is needed on the host.
Sound effects and music both work where a PulseAudio server is reachable, and the game runs silently where one is not, which is the usual case on a server. Game data is not included: you supply an IWAD, and the freely redistributable shareware DOOM1.WAD is enough to play episode one.
Issues and questions go to the GitHub tracker linked below.
